chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
In Shahi, once all of the sales orders are shipped then Style moves to OCR category. These styles start listing in OCR workplace where different department teams perform different action and update.
Once a style is flagged as closed by all the relevant department, subject style is submitted for BI Team review. Upon receipt of style BI team analyse transaction status related to respective style and confirm on OCR closure.
Styles post OCR closure are taken in periodic MIS for various management meetings. In essence, OCR is the formal closure of a styles and respective sales orders.
During this OCR multiple activities are performed in control environment which are explained in detail in this document.

chunks.title: List Controls
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › Order Closure Workplace › … › List Controls
chunks.text:
Initiate OCR : This will user level configuration field which will be visible only once configured for respective user. User will be able to trigger OCR process selecting a OCR line and click on Initiate OCR Process tool.
Close Audit: This will user level configuration field which will be visible only once configured for respective user. User will be able to close OCR process by click on this tool. User will be able to Accept and Reject OCR request with comments. These comments will be visible on Line level Action history.
Log: There should be an Audit log covering date of initiation and Auditor comments with approval and rejection.
Task Closure: - Each department will have an option to close the task. However, if his responsible task (Like Open Indents, In Transit PO) are not zero then system will not allow to close the task. User can also select multiple lines to close the task.
x
Reason for delay: - If after 3 days of OCR initiation, if any task is not closed then there will be a reason for deploy which team has to mention. It will a dropdown and required a master in Sales Codes Reason for Delay for OCR.
On clicking Order Closure, a pop-up should appear with a text area where the user must enter remarks. The pop-up should also provide two buttons: Approve and Reject.
• When the user clicks Approve, the OCR will be closed, and its status should be updated to Closed.

chunks.title: OCR FG Stock
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › OCR Summary › OCR FG Stock
chunks.text:
This screen will show all FGs with quality status. system should also facilitate quality categorization of rejected PCS like, rejected, B Grade etc. –
This screen will also have option to Trigger QC inspection Request and FG transfer request.
Max aging will be calculated from First GRN of that Stock.
If the QC status is still Pending or In Progress, and the user clicks the Transfer link, the system should display an appropriate alert message as “QC is not completed, so you cannot Transfer the Stock”
When user will click on QC then QC List will open and it will filter the QC request for the selected line stock.
When user click on Transfer link then system will open the Adhoc transfer to Site Screen. The to warehouse will the store of the stock.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirement. › OCR Summary › OCR FG Stock

chunks.title: Stock Reuse
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › OCR Summary › Stock Reuse
chunks.text:
Any leftover material allocation to other Style OC post or during OCR will be listed here.
In case, reallocation of stock is pending for approval then status will be shown as “In-progress” else it will “Closed”.
Validations:
• OCR will be user base configurable
• Return Qty. should also consider for threshold calculation.
• Order Quantity: 1,000 pcs
• Shipment Threshold: 90%
• Return Quantity: 50 pcs
• Net Shipped Quantity: 850 pcs (900 shipped − 50 returned)
Calculation:
• Required for OCR = 900 pcs
• Net Shipment = 850 pcs
• Result: OCR Not Eligible because return quantity is deducted from the shipped quantity while calculating the threshold.
• if shipment quantity changes after OCR has already started then it will show in – progress.
• Merchant will not open a completed task.
• After OCR closure auditor is not able to re-open an OCR.
• After initiation user is not able to cancel OCR.
